PM Modi Highlights India's Growth, Criticizes Past Policy Paralysis

Prime Minister Narendra Modi, speaking at the 100th anniversary event of Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC), stated that India has moved from 'policy paralysis' to 'policy dynamism'. He highlighted India's 7.8% GDP growth, attributing it partly to overcoming trade challenges caused by the West Asia war. Modi also criticized those associated with the 'fragile 5' period for questioning the current growth figures. During his visit, the Prime Minister adopted a 'Gen Z' style of communication, using contemporary slang to connect with students and alumni.
